title: 在街上問路 — Asking for Directions
context: You are visiting Taipei and need to find the nearest MRT station.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! qǐngwèn nǐ yào qù nǎlǐ?
turns.translation: Hello! May I ask where you are going?
turns.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ！ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ？
turns.romanization: nǐ hǎo! qǐngwèn nǐ yào qù nǎlǐ?
turns.translation_en: Hello! May I ask where you are going?
turns.translation_id: Halo! Boleh tanya mau ke mana?

choices.hanzi: 你好！請問捷運站在哪裡？
choices.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! qǐngwèn jiéyùn zhàn zài nǎlǐ?
choices.translation: Hello! May I ask where the MRT station is?
choices.feedback: Politely asking for directions to the MRT.
choices.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ！ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄩㄣˋ ㄓㄢˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ？

choices.feedback: Too early to end the conversation.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.hanzi: 往前走，在第二個路口左轉就到了。
turns.pinyin: wǎng qián zǒu, zài dì èr ge lùkǒu zuǒ zhuǎn jiù dào le.
turns.translation: Go straight, turn left at the second intersection and you'll arrive.
turns.zhuyin: ㄨㄤˇ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄗㄡˇ， ㄗㄞˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄦˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄎㄡˇ ㄗㄨㄛˇ ㄓㄨㄢˇ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄌㄜ˙。
turns.text: 往前走，在第二個路口左轉就到了。
turns.romanization: wǎng qián zǒu, zài dì èr ge lùkǒu zuǒ zhuǎn jiù dào le.
turns.translation_en: Go straight, turn left at the second intersection and you'll arrive.
turns.translation_id: Lurus ke depan, belok kiri di persimpangan kedua, kamu sampai.

choices.feedback: You're the one asking for directions.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: bú kèqì! zhù nǐ wán dé kāixīn!
turns.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˋ ㄎㄜˋ ㄑㄧˋ！ ㄓㄨˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄨㄢˊ ㄉㄜˊ ㄎㄞ ㄒㄧㄣ！
